_about: AAA check 7 (docs/plans/mission-control/aaa-rating.md): every data panel on a page needs passing vitest tests for its LOADED, EMPTY and ERROR states. Each entry is a module path relative to dashboard/, without extension. Scored by scripts/mission_control_panel_coverage.py. A page with no data panels lists none and scores N/A, which the scorer does not count as met. Shell panels (MC-00) are the layout's own data components, listed once rather than on every page.

_notes.MC-15: The page's own tool catalogue is not a data panel: getToolCatalogue() returns the static KNOWN_TOOLS list plus any MCP names found in a local Hermes config, and a missing or unreadable config silently leaves the static list (lib/command-centre/tools/catalogue.ts). It has no loading, empty or error state to test. Its data panels are the two tiles.
_notes.MC-13, MC-14: Static pages: the index is links, and Hermes renders getControlPanelView(), which has no imports, fetch, file or env reads (lib/command-centre/control-panel.ts).
